title: Analista administrativo & financeiro | Híbrido
description:
Analista administrativo & financeiro (f/m)

Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Tempo integral; horário comercial - flexível

Data de início: imediato

Sistema híbrido: trabalho remoto & presencial


We are act.3

A equipe sempre ganha – e é assim que jogamos. Mantemos a autenticidade – como um time diverso de indivíduos talentosos, agimos juntos para tornar nosso mundo um lugar mais feliz. Explore mais sobre nossa cultura comunitária aqui:


Acreditamos que o impacto real vem de pessoas e de histórias reais. Todos têm uma história para contar e é importante que sejam ouvidos e valorizados. Não importa de onde você vem, como você é ou qual é sua paixão, nós celebramos nossa singularidade e fortalecemos ativamente um mundo inclusivo e equitativo para todos. Nossa comunidade é para todos, assim como nosso local de trabalho.


O QUE VOCÊ FARÁ

Você apoiará a gerência nas áreas Administrativa, Financeira e de Recursos Humanos.


Fará parte de uma equipe engajada, atuando na área administrativa do processamento de contas a pagar e contas a receber, no gerenciamento da área de suprimentos, na gestão de documentação e bancos de dados, além de prestar suporte ao setor de Recursos Humanos.


Além disso, auxiliará na preparação da documentação contábil, sendo responsável pelo apoio na condução do ciclo orçamentário, participando da gestão de processos e elaborando relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas.


Adicionalmente, participará de reuniões internacionais relacionadas a projetos globais.


Você desempenhará um papel estratégico no controle e na análise das atividades que impactam diretamente a gestão da empresa.


VOCÊ IRÁ ATIVAMENTE...


  • Ser responsável pela área de contas a pagar; analisando e processando a documentação fiscal, garantindo conformidade com normas fiscais e tributárias (experiência intermediária com impostos, acompanhando as atualizações da legislação quanto as retenções); Lançamento de despesas e custos no sistema financeiro.
  • Apoiar na gestão do fluxo de caixa, auxiliando no planejamento orçamentário e na elaboração de previsões financeiras.
  • Gerenciar a área de suprimentos (cadastro, contratos, prazos de pagamento), auxiliando na gestão de fornecedores incluindo a documentação da rede nacional e internacional de fornecedores.
  • Administrar as contas a receber; emitindo notas fiscais nacionais e faturas internacionais. Lançar a documentação fiscal no sistema financeiro. 
  • Auxiliar na área de recursos humanos; atendimento às demandas de benefícios, capacitação e treinamentos; gestão de dados, envio de relatórios à matriz global; atualizar formulários de colaboradores.
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de documentação contábil; análise e processamento dos lançamentos contábeis nacionais e internacionais; controle e verificação de demonstrativos contábeis de DRE, balancetes e Balanço Patrimonial. 
  • Apoiar a preparação de dados e informações para o ciclo orçamentário trimestral; preparar, aprimorar e desenvolver dashboards apresentações executivas internas por meio de relatórios elaborados.
  • Realizar e aprimorar as análises dos resultados financeiros de projetos; atualizando os indicadores do orçado x realizado; elaborando relatórios de resultados com planilhas e gráficos com análises gerenciais.


QUEM VOCÊ É

Profissional com experiencia de 2-3 anos, com sólida atuação na área de administração ou finanças. Formação superior completa, preferencialmente em Administração, Finanças, Economia, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas afins.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Portuguese) - 62131
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Risk Management Manager
description:
To proactively safeguard the Business Unit’s financial integrity and profitability by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating financial control gaps, operational risks, and governance weaknesses at BU level. This role acts as the internal financial protection authority within the Business Unit, ensuring early detection of risk exposure, structured gap analysis, and effective remediation execution. The position complements — and does not duplicate — the Platform Internal Controls function. While Platform owns the global framework, policies, and external audit interface, this role ensures local control effectiveness, business-specific risk mitigation, and protection of financial performance within the BU perimeter.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct proactive financial risk assessments across core processes (R2R, O2C, P2P, Inventory, CAPEX, Payroll), identifying structural and operational control weaknesses.
  • Perform deep-dive diagnostic reviews in high-risk entities, functions, or processes to identify financial exposure, control gaps, fraud risk, or segregation-of-duties conflicts.
  • Analyze gaps identified by Platform Internal Controls and ensure effective remediation within the BU, acting as execution and follow-up owner.
  • Develop and implement BU-specific preventive control mechanisms to protect profitability, working capital, assets, and cash flow.
  • Monitor financial risk indicators (e.g., abnormal margin deviations, working capital anomalies, manual journal entries, CAPEX deviations) and escalate risks to BU leadership when necessary.
  • Lead internal financial investigations of irregularities or control breakdowns, in coordination with Platform Governance, Legal, and HR where applicable.
  • Support the BU CFO in evaluating financial exposure related to new business initiatives, structural changes, integrations, or operational transformations.
  • Ensure effective segregation of duties and ERP/system-based control integrity in collaboration with IT and Finance Operations.
  • Promote a financial risk awareness culture within BU Finance and Operations through targeted training and structured governance communication.
  • Provide periodic risk exposure reporting to BU Leadership, including quantified risk assessment, remediation status, and potential financial impact.


REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration.
  • Experience in Internal Audit, Financial Controlling, or Internal Controls within multinational industrial environments.
  • Minimum requirement: Fluent English, Fluent Portuguese.

Desirable:

  • Fluent German.
  • MBA or professional certification in Audit, Risk, or Accounting (CPA, CIA, CIMA or equivalent).


Hard Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of financial processes and risk exposure areas.
  • Expertise in internal control gap assessment and remediation design.
  • Financial risk analysis and exposure quantification.
  • ERP control environment understanding.
  • Fraud risk identification and prevention.
  • Strong analytical capability (variance, margin, working capital diagnostics).
  • Segregation of duties and governance framework principles.
  • Experience in multi-entity or international industrial environments.

title: Especialista em Vendas no Balcão (OTC)
description:
A Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviços de eletrônica náutica com mais de 500 funcionários em 60 centros de serviço em 22 países, incluindo Américas, África, Ásia e Europa. A Mackay oferece salários competitivos, além de horas extras, e benefícios como seguro saúde/odontológico, férias remuneradas, vale-refeição e vale-transporte.

As responsabilidades também incluirão manuseio de materiais e envio/recebimento de mercadorias, o que envolve levantamento físico, manuseio de caixas, paleteiras e pode incluir atividades em escadas, elevadores, empilhadeiras, ferramentas elétricas, ferramentas manuais, transporte e movimentação de peças e equipamentos.

title: Technical BIM Designer / Computational Revit Specialist
description:
Role Overview


The Technical BIM Designer will support Ecotone’s technical drafting and modeling workflows by developing detailed Revit models, coordinating with engineering consultants, and implementing automation tools that improve production efficiency and model quality.


This role requires a strong understanding of construction documentation, engineering coordination, and fabrication-oriented modeling , along with the ability to develop computational workflows using Dynamo.


Candidates should be comfortable working in technically complex BIM environments where models directly support construction execution.



Requirements



Advanced Revit Expertise


Applicants must demonstrate strong professional proficiency in Revit modeling and documentation within architectural or construction environments.


Candidates should have significant experience with:


• Worksharing environments

• Complex family creation

• Advanced schedules and parameter management

• Maintaining model integrity across multidisciplinary teams



Dynamo Automation


Proven experience developing and maintaining Dynamo graphs to automate repetitive modeling and documentation workflows.


Candidates should be comfortable using Dynamo to:


• automate documentation tasks

• streamline modeling workflows

• enforce BIM standards

• reduce manual drafting work




Computational BIM Workflow Experience


Experience implementing data-driven BIM processes using Dynamo or similar tools to manage parameters, enforce standards, and perform automated quality control checks within large Revit models.




Design-Build Project Experience


Experience working in design-build or construction-integrated environments where BIM models directly support construction documentation, coordination, and fabrication.


Candidates should understand how digital models translate into construction outcomes.




Construction Documentation and Technical Detailing


Strong experience producing detailed construction documents in Revit.


Candidates should be comfortable developing:


• wall assemblies

• sections and details

• millwork and specialty architectural systems

• coordination details with engineering systems




MEP and Engineering Coordination


Demonstrated experience coordinating architectural models with mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural systems within multidisciplinary BIM environments.


Candidates should be able to identify and resolve system conflicts directly within the BIM model.




Fabrication-Oriented Modeling


Experience producing highly detailed models that support:


• shop drawing development

• prefabrication workflows

• contractor installation and coordination




Buildability Awareness


Working knowledge of construction sequencing, material tolerances, installation constraints, and contractor workflows.


Models and drawings must reflect real-world construction logic, not conceptual architecture.




Professional Experience Requirement


This role is intended for experienced BIM professionals.


Applicants who are early in their careers, seeking training in Revit fundamentals, or looking for entry-level drafting roles will not be considered.




Bonus Qualifications



Python within Dynamo


Ability to write custom Python scripts inside Dynamo to extend functionality and bypass node limitations.




Revit API Development


Experience developing custom automation tools or add-ins using the Revit API.




Why Work at Ecotone


Ecotone offers the opportunity to work on technically complex projects that integrate architecture, engineering coordination, fabrication, and construction.


Team members gain exposure to:


• advanced BIM workflows

• construction-integrated design environments

• highly specialized architectural systems

• real-world design-build problem solving

O trabalho envolve repetição de padrão com rigor criativo: criar variações de um mesmo ativo, adaptar formatos e manter a identidade visual da marca impecável em todos os pontos de contato.

O projeto ocorrerá em um ambiente dinâmico, com prazos curtos, mudanças de demanda e momentos de alta intensidade, especialmente durante os jogos. Transparência, proatividade e comunicação constante com a liderança e o cliente são tão importantes quanto a qualidade das entregas.

title: Over-the Counter (OTC) Sales Specialist
description:
Mackay Marine is a global marine electronics service company with more than 500 employees across 60 service depots in twenty-two (22) countries, including the America's, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Mackay offers competitive salaries plus overtime, and benefits such as health/dental insurance, holiday leave, meal and transportation vouchers are available as well.

Mackay is currently seeking a fulltime and experienced Marine Over the Counter (OTC) Specialist who is proficient in English , to work onsite at our Rio location. Individuals with the skills and qualifications outlined below are encouraged to apply.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB SUMMARY

The OTC Specialist is an onsite, non-managerial position which reports to the Managing Director for Brazil. The responsibilities of the OTC Specialist include but are not limited to communicating directly with our customers to answer questions concerning the availability, price, and use of merchandise as well as providing technical guidance, timely quotations, and comprehensive proposals. Will process over-the-counter transactions, special orders, phone-in and internet sales orders as well as inter-company transfers. Will support other team members, customers and company accounts with parts ordering and fulfillment to support our business.

Responsibilities will also include material handling and shipping/receiving of goods which includes physical lifting, handling of boxes, pallet jacks and may include activities on ladders, lifts, forklift, power tools, hand tools, carrying and moving of parts and equipment.

OTC SPECIALIST JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Acts as the point of contact for customer sales, service, and information requests to ensure that customer needs are fulfilled with speed and professionalism.
  • Assist in the research of basic technical issues on products and service. Collect symptoms of customer problems and facilitate repairs.
  • Assist with incoming sales prospects or customer calls when outside sales staff are out of the office.
  • Provide customer quotes, proposals, and will follow up in a timely manner.
  • Build the business by identifying revenue opportunities within the marine industry.
  • Assist with the shipping and receiving functions to help facilitate the trafficking and accountability for all materials received and delivered for customer orders, inventory, repairs, or for internal use.
  • Direct service requests the appropriate team member.
  • Maintain work area and stockroom in a clean and orderly fashion.
  • Read customer orders, work orders, shipping orders, or requisitions to determine items to be moved, gathered, or distributed and/or shipped using Mackay’s ERP system.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST SKILLS NEEDED:

  • Prior knowledge of Marine electronic equipment is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as product brochures, operating and maintenance instructions, procedure manuals, etc.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percentage.
  • Attention to detail and ability to organize materials effectively and efficiently.
  • Excellent customer service, communication (both oral and written), organizational, planning, and prioritization skills.


OTC SALES SPECIALIST QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Two years of post-secondary education.
  • Electronics and/or marine background preferred.
  • Three years of inside or counter sales experience.
  • Good computer and Internet skills
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation.


Applicants must be authorized to work in Brazil without sponsorship.  Successful completion of a thorough background check will be required upon acceptance of an employment offer.

Sua função não é apenas vender – é transformar vidas, orientar, gerar confiança e mostrar um caminho possível para quem está sufocado por dívidas.

A cada contrato fechado, uma vida recomeça. Isso tem nome: propósito.

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

description:

title: Senior QA Embedded Engineer
description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the Role


We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Test Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. This role is key to support this team, validating and debugging all Vammo’s hardware ecosystem, including IoT devices, electronics modules for vehicles and battery swap framework.


What you’ll do


  • Develop and maintain automated test plans, test cases and scripts to validate hardware products from development through manufacturing;
  • Translate product requirements into test plans and test cases;
  • Work closely with hardware/firmware engineers to identify the needed tests during development;
  • Validate a firmware release according to the product requirements;
  • Work closely with software team to validate a seamlessly API integration with hardware, involving testing backoffice tools and mobile applications;
  • Collaborate with development team to create, validate and deploy test solutions in the manufacturing process (factory test firmware, test jigs, etc);
  • Debugging and troubleshooting using embedded debug tools;
  • Communicate test progress and test status to key stakeholders clearly;


What we’re looking for


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related field. Equivalent hands-on testing embedded systems may also be considered;
  • Experience with serial protocols (CAN, RS485, RS232) and hardware peripherals (USART, I2C, SPI, GPIO);
  • 6+ years in testing embedded systems, ideally in automotive, mobility, or other mission-critical hardware;
  • Skilled at Python programming for test automation;
  • Experience with HIL tools;
  • Experience with stress, performance and security tests;
  • Proven ability to debug complex firmware/electronics integration issues;
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where firmware is critical to product launch. Startup experience is a plus;
  • Fluent or advanced English, speaking, reading and writing (we have constant discussions in English with all the team);
  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with C or C++ languages to help on unit testing;
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks: Robot framework or Pytest for embedded systems;
  • Familiarity with wireless communication protocols (LTE, BLE, WiFi), cloud/IoT integration (MQTT and protobuff) and Linux network layers.


What You’ll Get


  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America’s most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.

Um grupo educacional em expansão está selecionando Formadores(as) Educacionais para atuação em projeto de formação de professores da rede pública , com atividades presenciais em diferentes municípios do Estado do Maranhão .


Atuação presencial no Maranhão

Projeto temporário – até 4 meses

Contratação PJ (prestação de serviços)

⏱ Carga horária: 40 horas semanais


Municípios de atuação

O candidato deve residir ou ter fácil deslocamento para um dos municípios abaixo:


Barra do Corda • Pinheiro • Bacabal • Lago da Pedra • Caxias • Rosário • Codó

São João dos Patos • Chapadinha • Presidente Dutra • Viana • Pedreiras

São Luís • Itapecuru Mirim • Açailândia • Imperatriz • Timon

Zé Doca • Santa Inês • Balsas



Requisito obrigatório de experiência na rede pública


Para participar do processo seletivo, o profissional deve obrigatoriamente atender a uma das condições abaixo :


✔ Ter experiência ou passagem pela rede pública municipal de ensino , ou

✔ Ter atuado anteriormente na rede pública estadual

Profissionais não podem estar atualmente atuando nem licenciados da rede pública estadual do Maranhão .



Principais responsabilidades:


• Conduzir formações presenciais para professores e equipes gestoras

• Realizar acompanhamento pedagógico nas escolas

• Estudar e aplicar materiais didáticos da empresa

• Implementar planos formativos alinhados à metodologia do projeto

• Produzir relatórios técnicos de acompanhamento

• Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e planejamento



Requisitos obrigatórios:


• Residência no Estado do Maranhão

• Graduação em Pedagogia ou Licenciaturas

• Pós-graduação concluída na área da Educação ou correlata

• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em formação educacional ou atuação pedagógica na rede pública

• Experiência com governo ou setor público educacional

• Disponibilidade para viagens frequentes dentro do estado

• Computador próprio com pacote Office

• Internet estável para reuniões e relatórios



Diferenciais:


• Veículo próprio para deslocamento

• Experiência com implementação de materiais estruturados

• Experiência em formação de professores da Educação Básica



Regime de contratação:


Tipo de contrato: Prestação de serviços (PJ)

Carga horária: 40 horas semanais

Duração do projeto: até 4 meses

Remuneração: a combinar

title: Project Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Project Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities):

  • As a Project Manager, you will be responsible for planning and executing projects and/or work package(s) that deliver agreed outcomes on time, in scope, on budget and to the required quality, while ensuring stakeholder satisfaction.
  • The role will require cross-functional team working, managing/interacting with third parties whilst exercising robust governance, risk and change control
  • Project and Work Package Planning
  • Define objectives, scope and deliverables in collaboration with stakeholders
  • Develop detailed project plans, schedules, resource allocations and budgets
  • Establish project governance, reporting structures, and success criteria.
  • Project and Work Package Execution
  • Lead project teams to deliver outputs according to plan
  • Coordinate activities across internal teams, external vendors and partners
  • Monitor progress and adjust plans as needed to ensure successful delivery.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders
  • Provide regular project updates, status reports, and presentations
  • Manage expectations and ensure alignment between stakeholders and project teams
  • Risk and Issue Management
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project and work package risks
  • Track issues and implement effective resolution strategies
  • Escalate critical risks or issues to senior leadership when necessary
  • Quality and Performance Management
  • Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and business requirements.
  • Monitor project performance using relevant metrics and KPIs.
  • Conduct project reviews and capture lessons learned.
  • Financial and Resource Management
  • Track project budgets and manage resource utilization.
  • Ensure effective allocation of team members and other project resources.
  • Project and Work Package Documentation and Reporting
  • Maintain accurate documentation including plans, schedules, and reports.


Mandatory Skills

  • Advanced English
  • Proven experience as a Project Manager or in a similar role
  • Experience of working on projects delivering technical modular platforms - not essential
  • Familiarity with project management frameworks (e.g., Waterfall, Agile, or hybrid approaches)
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams across departments and business units
  • Understanding of project governance, reporting structures and performance metrics
  • Project Management certification (e.g. PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, APM PMQ or equivalent) - desirable
  • Agile certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Master) - not essential
  • Experience with project management software (e.g. MS Project)"


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Totalpass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Engenheiro(a) de Propostas & Aplicação
description:
A CHINT está em busca de um(a) Especialista de Propostas (Alta Tensão) para atuar em projetos de energia. O(A) profissional será responsável por definir a melhor solução para cada projeto dentre os produtos do portfólio da empresa, além de desenvolver e coordenar a elaboração propostas técnicas e comerciais, garantindo que todas as especificações e requisitos do cliente sejam atendidas de forma precisa e dentro dos padrões exigidos. Essa posição requer forte conhecimento em sistemas elétricos e subestações, além de habilidades de comunicação eficazes para interagir com equipes internas, fornecedores e clientes.


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar os requisitos dos projetos elétricos a partir dos documentos fornecidos pelos clientes, identificando as necessidades técnicas e comerciais e apontar os equipamentos que melhor se encaixam nas soluções.
  • Elaborar propostas técnicas detalhadas, especificando os equipamentos de sistemas de subestações, como transformadores, disjuntores, seccionadores, painéis de média tensão, sistemas de proteção e controle, entre outros.
  • Preparar orçamentos e cronogramas, garantindo que todos os custos sejam calculados corretamente e dentro das margens de rentabilidade da empresa.
  • Interagir com fornecedores para obter cotações e informações sobre materiais e equipamentos.
  • Garantir que todas as normas e regulamentações técnicas de segurança e qualidade sejam observadas durante a elaboração da proposta.
  • Auxiliar na negociação com clientes e na definição das condições contratuais.
  • Realizar apresentações para clientes, quando necessário, explicando a solução proposta e os benefícios dos produtos e serviços.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia, comercial e gestão de projetos para garantir que a proposta esteja alinhada com as capacidades da empresa e com as expectativas do cliente.
  • Participar de revisões internas e externas de propostas, assegurando que todos os aspectos técnicos e comerciais sejam atendidos.


Requisitos:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento técnico sobre sistemas elétricos de subestações, componentes de distribuição e transmissão de energia e normas regulatórias.
  • Habilidade em análise e interpretação de documentos técnicos, como especificações, normas e desenhos elétricos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto verbais quanto escritas, com capacidade para elaborar relatórios e apresentações.
  • Experiência com softwares de engenharia e ferramentas de orçamentação.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar e em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Desejável inglês intermediário/avançado para comunicação com fornecedores internacionais.


Diferenciais:

  • Pós-graduação em áreas relacionadas a engenharia de energia ou gestão de projetos.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (como MS Project ou similares).
  • Experiência prévia em empresas do setor elétrico ou engenharia de infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em produtos de alta tensão, geração solar, carregadores elétricos e controle de automação.

title: Técnico de campo
description:

Local: Americana – SP

A Varpe Brasil é especializada no desenvolvimento e fabricação de equipamentos de inspeção industrial, incluindo:

·      Checkweighers (controle de peso dinâmico)

·      Detectores de metais industriais

Para garantir a operação contínua desses sistemas, buscamos um Técnico de Campo (Field Service Technician) para atuar com assistência técnica industrial, manutenção industrial e suporte técnico em máquinas industriais diretamente no site do cliente.

Orientar equipes do cliente sobre operação e cuidados básicos com os equipamentos

Participar de projetos de retrofit, upgrade e melhorias técnicas em automação industrial

Formação técnica em:

·      Mecatrônica

·      Automação Industrial

·      Eletroeletrônica

·      Eletrônica

·      ou áreas correlatas

Experiência com:

title: Especialista de Produtos – Trauma e Medicina Esportiva
description:
Especialista de Produtos – Trauma e Medicina Esportiva


São Caetano do Sul – SP | Presencial | Disponibilidade para viagens


A Importek, empresa referência no mercado hospitalar de dispositivos médicos, com atuação em OPME/CME, busca um Especialista de Produtos – Trauma e Medicina Esportiva para atuar no desenvolvimento técnico e estratégico do portfólio de produtos, suporte às equipes comerciais e relacionamento com médicos e distribuidores.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar demonstrações técnicas dos produtos para equipes médicas, distribuidores e clientes, destacando funcionalidades, diferenciais e benefícios clínicos.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida dos produtos, desde a análise de mercado e desenvolvimento até o lançamento e acompanhamento pós-mercado.
  • Realizar análises de mercado e benchmarking, identificando oportunidades de inovação, tendências e posicionamento frente à concorrência.
  • Apoiar as áreas de Marketing e Vendas, garantindo que os produtos estejam corretamente posicionados e alinhados às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Ministrar treinamentos técnicos para equipes internas, distribuidores e profissionais da área da saúde.
  • Desenvolver materiais técnicos e de marketing, incluindo apresentações, treinamentos, guias técnicos e conteúdos de apoio ao time comercial.
  • Participar de congressos, feiras e eventos científicos, fortalecendo o relacionamento com médicos, distribuidores, speakers e KOLs (Key Opinion Leaders).
  • Atuar como referência técnica para produtos como implantes, instrumentais, descartáveis e equipamentos.
  • Realizar acompanhamento cirúrgico e suporte técnico em procedimentos, garantindo o correto uso dos produtos.
  • Apoiar programas de pós-mercado e vigilância de produtos, colaborando com áreas como Qualidade, Engenharia de Produto e Assuntos Regulatórios.
  • Participar da identificação e avaliação de novos produtos e fornecedores, alinhados às tendências tecnológicas e às necessidades do mercado.
  • Desenvolver e conduzir treinamentos para distribuidores e equipes comerciais, promovendo conhecimento técnico e fortalecimento do portfólio.


Requisitos

  • Formação superior na área da saúde, engenharia biomédica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida com produtos de Trauma e Medicina Esportiva.
  • Vivência no mercado hospitalar com OPME.
  • Conhecimento técnico em produtos como implantes ortopédicos, instrumentais e equipamentos cirúrgicos.
  • Experiência com treinamentos técnicos, suporte clínico e acompanhamento cirúrgico.
  • Conhecimento em anatomia e procedimentos cirúrgicos ortopédicos, como:
  • Artroscopia de joelho e ombro
  • Procedimentos de medicina esportiva
  • Procedimentos de trauma ortopédico
  • Experiência no relacionamento com distribuidores, médicos e equipes hospitalares.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e participação em eventos e congressos.


Diferenciais

  • Inglês fluente
  • Experiência prévia com lançamento de produtos médicos

  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.

  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Human Resources Manager
 
Company Overview
Our client is an international gold exploration and development company advancing a large gold project in the Pará State, one of Brazil’s most important historic gold districts. The project includes multiple near-surface gold deposits within a highly prospective land package and benefits from good regional infrastructure and proximity to established mining communities.
As the company moves forward with project development and construction activities, it is building a strong local team to support the next phase of growth and future operations, with a focus on responsible mining practices and positive community engagement.
 
Job Summary
The Human Resources Manager will lead the HR function for a gold mining operation in Pará, Brazil, transitioning from the project phase into construction and subsequently full operations. This role is responsible for building and implementing the HR strategy, systems, and workforce required to support a safe, efficient, and compliant mining operation. The position will oversee workforce planning, recruitment, employee relations, training, and HR governance while ensuring alignment with Brazilian labor legislation and company policies.
 
Accountabilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
 
  • HR Strategy & Workforce Planning: Develop and implement the HR strategy to support the transition from project development to construction and operational phases. Plan and manage workforce ramp-up for construction and operational teams. Establish HR policies, procedures, and systems appropriate for a remote mining environment. Partner with leadership to support organizational design and workforce productivity.
  • Recruitment & Talent Acquisition: Lead recruitment efforts for technical, operational, and administrative roles required during construction and operations. Develop local hiring strategies that prioritize community engagement and regional workforce participation.Build relationships with local training institutions, contractors, and recruitment partners.
  • Employee Relations & Labor Compliance: Ensure compliance with Brazilian labor laws, mining regulations, and company policies. Manage employee relations, disciplinary processes, and grievance resolution. Support union interactions if applicable and maintain constructive labor relations.
  • Compensation, Benefits & HR Administration: Develop competitive compensation and benefits structures aligned with the mining industry in Brazil. Oversee payroll coordination, benefits administration, and HR reporting. Maintain accurate employee records and HR metrics.
  • Training & Development: Implement training programs for workforce development, safety awareness, and leadership capability. Support competency frameworks for operational roles. Coordinate onboarding programs for new employees and contractors.
  • Health, Safety & Culture: Work closely with HSE teams to promote a strong safety culture across the workforce. Support initiatives that reinforce company values, ethical conduct, and diversity and inclusion.Foster a positive workplace culture in a remote mining environment.
  • Community & Stakeholder Engagement: Support local employment initiatives and community engagement programs. Ensure responsible hiring practices aligned with social commitments in the region. Collaborate with sustainability and community relations teams.
 
Requirements
The ideal candidate must have:
  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of HR experience, with at least 5 years in mining, heavy industry, construction, or large-scale industrial projects.
  • Proven experience supporting project-to-operations transitions is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian labor law and HR best practices.
  • Experience managing HR functions in remote or camp-based operations is preferred.
  • Fluent Portuguese required; English proficiency strongly preferred.
 
Skills & Competencies: Strategic HR leadership and workforce planning, Strong recruitment and talent management capabilities, Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, Ability to work in multicultural and remote environments, Problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.
 
Additional Requirements
There is no specific rotation, but regular presence at the mine site is required.
Experience working in remote or developing regions is an asset.
 
The Rewards
The position offers a competitive remuneration package
 
Contact us
Please apply directly by submitting your resume, preferably as a Microsoft Word document

title: 投标经理
description:
We are a forward-looking pharmaceutical/medical device enterprise dedicated to providing high-quality medical products and professional solutions to the Brazilian healthcare industry. As we accelerate our market layout in Brazil, we are now seeking a seasoned and results-driven Medical Tendering Manager to join our team. In this core role, you will own the end-to-end tendering and market access work for our products in Brazil’s public and private healthcare systems, driving our product penetration and business growth in the local market.


Responsibilities:

I. Tendering Process Management

- Be responsible for the collection, analysis, and interpretation of tendering policies, regulations, and trends in the pharmaceutical and medical device sectors, ensuring that the company's bidding activities comply with local laws and regulations.

- Lead the application process for the company's products in tendering projects of health departments at all levels and public hospitals in Brazil.

- Manage and maintain various qualification documents, product registration documents, and compliance certificates required for tendering.

- Coordinate internal resources and external partners to ensure the timely and compliant completion of tendering projects.


II. Market Access and Strategy Planning

- Collect and analyze tendering data, competitors' bidding information, and price trends in the Brazilian pharmaceutical and medical device market, and formulate and implement bidding plans tailored to the Brazilian market.

- Evaluate the risks of tendering projects and develop corresponding response plans.


III. Compliance and Risk Management

- Monitor the performance of tendering contracts, manage the payment collection process, ensure the safety of funds, and report in a timely manner.

- Keep the company's business secrets confidential and maintain the company's good image and professional reputation during the tendering process.


Job Requirements:

- Education and Major: Bachelor's degree or above, with a background in pharmacy, biomedical engineering, marketing, international trade, or related fields.

- Experience: Have more than 8 years of work experience in the pharmaceutical or medical device industry, have a profound understanding of the Brazilian pharmaceutical regulatory system and tendering process, and possess successful bidding cases.

- Abilities: Have excellent business negotiation skills, cross-cultural communication skills (proficiency in English is preferred), and data analysis capabilities. Be able to withstand work pressure and have a strong sense of responsibility.

- Resources: Clinical network, terminal agent resources, or a relationship network with local health departments in Brazil are preferred.

title: Leader Supply Chain Operations, Americas
description:
Our growing manufacturing client is hiring a Supply Chain Operations Leader, Americas who will lead all supply chain activities for three manufacturing sites across the Americas, establishing synergies between sites to improve efficiency and reduce costs. This leader will drive S&OP processes, manage material budgets, and oversee supplier performance for both direct and indirect materials, ensuring on-time delivery for commercial and defense aerospace programs.


Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership & Optimization: Develop and implement multi-site supply chain strategies to achieve business goals, including lean manufacturing initiatives and reducing supply chain risk.
  • Supplier Management & Negotiation: Lead negotiations for long-term contracts, manage supplier relationships, and drive cost-reduction initiatives (PPV - Purchase Price Variance).
  • Production Planning & Inventory Control: Oversee material planning, inventory levels, and production scheduling to ensure continuity of supply, minimizing excess inventory while maintaining 100% on-time delivery.
  • Project Management: Manage multiple development projects from planning to cutover and change management. Collaborate with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand needs and develop innovative solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with manufacturing, engineering, quality, and program management to align sourcing decisions with technical requirements.
  • Operational Excellence: Lead monthly SIOP (Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning) processes and monitor supply chain KPIs (SQDC - Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost) to implement corrective actions.
  • Talent Development: Lead and mentor a team of supply chain professionals across the region, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with aerospace quality standards.


Required Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or Business Administration.
  • Experience: 5–10+ years of progressive experience in supply chain management within the aerospace or manufacturing industry, with proven experience in a multi-site environment.
  • Technical Skills: Deep knowledge SAP Materials Management Module, demand planning software, and inventory management techniques. Manage system integrations and data flow between SAP and other interfaced solutions. Apply advanced analytics and AI to drive efficiency and cost savings.
  • Leadership: Strong team management abilities, experience leading cross-functional teams, and a proven track record of driving process improvements.
  • Certifications: APICS (CPIM or CSCP) certification is highly preferred.
  • Travel: Ability to travel (50%) to support suppliers and other sites within the Americas.


Top Skills

  • Problem-Solving: Ability to solve complex, non-standardized problems and drive root cause analysis.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capability to align supply chain performance with long-term company goals.
  • Negotiation: Strong ability to secure favorable terms, pricing, and supplier performance.

title: Cutover Lead
description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP Cut Over Lead with strong leadership and communication skills to drive the critical transition


This role will be responsible for orchestrating all activities required to migrate the current SAP ECC 6.0 environment to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring business continuity and data integrity throughout the transition.


The position requires on-site presence 3 days per week at offices in São Paulo and close collaboration with key project stakeholders.


Key Responsibilities

Cutover Strategy & Planning

Define and document the detailed Cutover Plan (hour-by-hour, step-by-step), covering technical, functional, and business tasks.

Coordinate Dry Runs to validate timelines and identify potential risks.

Work with the Project PMO to define contingency plans and Go/No-Go criteria.

Stakeholder Management

Act as the main point of contact between the implementation team and business leaders.

Negotiate Blackout periods (operational freeze) with Supply Chain, Finance, and Sales teams, minimizing business disruption.

Provide clear and proactive communication on transition progress to senior leadership.

Execution & Go-Live

Lead the Command Center during the Go-Live phase.

Manage and resolve real-time issues during data migration and configuration transports.

Ensure alignment with the project PMO and that the business is fully prepared for Day 1 operations.

Requirements

Experience: 2–3 full-cycle SAP implementations, preferably S/4HANA, leading the Cutover process.

Methodology: Strong knowledge of SAP Activate.

Process Knowledge: Understanding of PTP (Procure-to-Pay) and RTR (Record-to-Report) processes, including data migration (ETL).

Stakeholder Management: Ability to engage with C-Level executives, Directors, and business leaders.

Soft Skills: Strong leadership, collaboration, and decision-making under pressure.

Languages: Fluent Portuguese and advanced English preferred.

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (mandatory).

title: Senior SRE Engineer (Temporary Contract)
description:
About You

This is a high‑impact, high‑expectation senior DevOps/SRE role supporting a Private Equity Group (PEG) platform. The team is new, the infrastructure is new, and the customer is extremely selective and private.


You must operate with strong autonomy , influence engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and serve as a thought partner rather than an order‑taker. You will work directly with VP‑level stakeholders in a technical environment where reliability, deployment safety, and clarity in communication are essential.


This position requires someone who can own DevOps architecture end‑to‑end , enable safe and frequent deployments, and establish operational excellence from day zero.


Note: This position is offered under a contractor model for a period of 6 months .


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies

  • Proven ownership of production-grade CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions reusable workflows and GitOps automation with ArgoCD .
  • Expert-level Kubernetes and EKS operations , including node group management, Karpenter autoscaling, RBAC, PDBs, and topology constraints.
  • Production-scale Terraform expertise , including module design, S3 + DynamoDB remote state , and PR-driven workflows via Atlantis .
  • Strong reliability engineering experience , including SLO/SLI design, alerting strategies, dashboards, incident response, and post-incident reviews.
  • Hands-on experience operating HashiCorp Vault , including auth backends, PKI, dynamic secrets, and audit logging.
  • Experience implementing supply-chain security controls , including image scanning and signing, SBOM generation, and policy enforcement with OPA/Gatekeeper.
  • Strong experience with observability stacks , including Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, and Alertmanager.
  • Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio , including traffic management, mTLS, AuthorizationPolicies, and circuit breaking.
  • Scripting ability using Python and Bash for automation and operational tooling.
  • Active use of AI-assisted engineering tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code to accelerate IaC development, incident response, and runbook generation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with VP-level stakeholders during operational incidents.
  • Advanced English proficiency, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain GitHub Actions reusable workflows across a multi-repository ecosystem.
  • Own GitOps deployments through ArgoCD , including promotion workflows, sync policies, drift detection, and automated rollback strategies.
  • Implement deployment safety mechanisms such as environment protections, concurrency rules, and verification gates .
  • Operate and upgrade EKS clusters , including Karpenter provisioning, node groups, and critical cluster add-ons.
  • Maintain Terraform-driven infrastructure and enforce PR-driven workflows through Atlantis.
  • Define and maintain SLOs, SLIs, alerting rules, and monitoring dashboards across platform services.
  • Lead incident response , coordinate recovery efforts, and execute structured post-incident reviews.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and contribute to improving operational processes.
  • Operate and maintain HashiCorp Vault , including policies, authentication backends, and secret engines.
  • Implement supply-chain security controls , including Trivy scanning, Cosign signing, SBOM generation, and OPA/Gatekeeper enforcement.
  • Partner with Security Engineering on network policies, egress controls, and compliance standards .
  • Automate repetitive tasks and maintain proactive runbooks to reduce operational risk.
  • Use AI tools to improve infrastructure automation, documentation, and deployment safety validation.
  • Collaborate with product teams to strengthen SLOs and deployment safety practices .
  • Challenge technical assumptions and advocate for scalable, secure DevOps architectures .


Qualifications

  • Proven end-to-end ownership of production-grade Kubernetes/EKS environments including Karpenter and Atlantis-driven Terraform workflows.
  • Demonstrated expertise with ArgoCD GitOps patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, supply-chain security controls, and structured incident response including on-call rotations and post-incident reviews.
  • Active use of AI-assisted tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Cloud Code as part of daily engineering workflow.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

In addition, the teacher manages Lower School choir activities and leads parent-facing performances and presentations, strengthening community engagement and celebrating student learning in alignment with the school’s mission and values.


Main Duties and Responsibilities

Instruction and Student Learning

  • Plan and deliver developmentally appropriate music instruction for Lower School students.
  • Teach foundational musical skills, including rhythm, melody, pitch, dynamics, and musical form.
  • Integrate singing, movement, instrument exploration, and creative expression into daily instruction.
  • Differentiate instruction to meet students’ diverse developmental, musical, and learning needs.
  • Foster student confi dence, collaboration, and joy in musical participation.


Lower School Choir Management

  • Direct and rehearse Lower School choir ensembles as appropriate by grade level.
  • Select age-appropriate and culturally diverse repertoire that refl ects the school’s values and community.
  • Teach healthy vocal technique, ensemble skills, and performance etiquette.
  • Prepare students for school concerts, assemblies, and community events.


Parent Presentations and Community Engagement

  • Plan and lead parent-facing performances, concerts, and musical presentations that showcase student learning.
  • Communicate clearly with families regarding performance expectations, schedules, and student progress.
  • Collaborate with classroom teachers and school leadership to integrate performances into the school calendar.
  • Promote music education
  • as a vital part of the Lower School experience.


Assessment and Feedback

  • Use formative and summative assessments to monitor student progress in musical skills and participation.
  • Provide constructive, age-appropriate feedback that supports student growth and confidence.
  • Maintain accurate records of student learning and participation.


Collaboration and Professional Practice

  • Collaborate with Lower School faculty, specialists, and student support staff to support interdisciplinary learning.
  • Participate actively in grade-level meetings, professional development, and school-wide initiatives.
  • Contribute to school events, celebrations, and community-building activities.
  • Demonstrate professionalism in attendance, punctuality, communication, and conduct.


Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Music Education or a related fi eld.
  • Valid teaching certifi cation/license in Music (U.S. or internationally recognized equivalent).


Desired

  • Master’s degree in Music Education or related discipline.
  • Training in early childhood or elementary music education methodologies (e.g., Orff, Kodály, Dalcroze).


Experience

Required

  • Minimum of five years of teaching experience.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching music to elementary-aged students.


Desired

  • Experience in international or multicultural school settings.
  • Experience directing children’s choirs and organizing school performances.
  • Experience working collaboratively with families and community audiences


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Required

  • Strong understanding of child development and age-appropriate music pedagogy.
  • Ability to teach singing, rhythm, movement, and basic instrumental skills.
  • Effective classroom management in active, performance-based learning environments.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with students, families, and colleagues.


Personal Attributes

  • Commitment to the school’s mission, vision, and values.
  • Warmth, enthusiasm, and patience in working with young children.
  • Professionalism, reliability, and strong organizational skills.
  • Collaborative, refl ective, and student-centered approach to teaching.

title: LLM Application Engineer
description:
The Role

You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.


What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem


Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

title: QA Embedded Engineer
description:
About Vammo


Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.


Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region’s most vulnerable populations.


The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.


About the Role


We are looking for a Junior Embedded Systems Test Engineer to join our Hardware Engineering team. This role is key to support this team, validating and debugging all Vammo’s hardware ecosystem, including IoT devices, electronics modules for vehicles and battery swap framework.


What you’ll do


  • Develop and maintain automated test plans, test cases and scripts to validate hardware products from development through manufacturing;
  • Help on translating product requirements into test plans and test cases;
  • Work closely with hardware/firmware engineers to identify the needed tests during development;
  • Validate a firmware release according to the product requirements;
  • Work closely with software team to validate a seamlessly API integration with hardware, involving testing backoffice tools and mobile applications;
  • Collaborate with development team to create, validate and deploy test solutions in the manufacturing process (factory test firmware, test jigs, etc);
  • Debugging and troubleshooting using embedded debug tools;
  • Help senior engineer to communicate test progress and test status to key stakeholders clearly;


What we’re looking for


  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related field. Equivalent hands-on testing embedded systems may also be considered;
  • Experience with serial protocols (CAN, RS485, RS232) and hardware peripherals (USART, I2C, SPI, GPIO);
  • 2+ years in testing embedded systems, ideally in automotive, mobility, or other mission-critical hardware;
  • Knowledge in Python programming for test automation;
  • Experience with stress and performance tests;
  • Proven ability to debug complex firmware/electronics integration issues;
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where firmware is critical to product launch. Startup experience is a plus;
  • Fluent or advanced English, speaking, reading and writing (we have constant discussions in English with all the team);
  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with C or C++ languages to help on unit testing;
  • Experience with HIL tools;
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks: Robot framework or Pytest for embedded systems;
  • Familiarity with wireless communication protocols (LTE, BLE, WiFi), cloud/IoT integration (MQTT and protobuff) and Linux network layers.


What You’ll Get


  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America’s most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.
